title: Concentrated load.
officialText:
Handrails and guards shall be able to resist a single concentrated load of 200 pounds (0.89
kN), applied in any direction at any point, and have attachment devices and supporting structure to transfer this loading to
appropriate structural elements of the building. This load need not be assumed to act concurrently with the loads specified
in the preceding paragraph.
